Rafique-ul-Huq, Senior Advocate instructed by AKM Shahidul Huq, Advocate-on-Record — For Respondent No. 8. 
Not represented— Respondent Nos. 1-7.
parties:
Standard Bank Ltd ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Tripos Engineering and Trading Company and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: Md Fazlul Karim J: The defendant Standard Bank Ltd seeks leave to appeal against the Judgment and order dated 16-11-2003 passed in Civil Revision No. 1673 of 2003 heard analogously with Civil Revision No. 1674 of 2003 as the issues involved in the Rules are the same and the contesting parties are also common. Respondent No. 1 in both the petitions filed the suit being Nos. 337 of 2001 and 338 of 2001 respectively in the 6th Court of Assistant Judge. Dhaka against the petitioner and others for a decree for declaration that any payment by virtue of back to back Letter of Credit (LC) as described in the plaint to be made by the Bank to other defendants as beneficiaries is illegal.
